'''Spectral attendants''' are found in the lower, middle, and upper south-west rooms of [[Nomad's Temple]] under [[Soul Wars]], during the [[Nomad's Requiem]] quest. The attendants are aggressive and attack using melee.

* [[Nomad's Temple]]
